2041.de: Head of a fair-haired girl in profile to the left. Short hair in gentle waves, wearing a purplish-grey dress. Background green.

2042.d: Esiplaanil hallis toonis põld, millel korvid ja kott, põllu servas seisab mehefiguur. Tagapool kitsas rohekas maariba, eraldatud mere poolt aiaga. Heledas taevas pilved markeeritud tumedamate pintslilöökidega.
2042.de: In the foreground a field in grey tones, with baskets and a bag on it, a male figure standing at the edge of the field. Behind it a narrow greenish strip of land, separated from the sea by a fence. In the light sky, clouds marked with darker brushstrokes.

2043.d: Lopsakate pintslilöökidega maalitud tükike rohelist maastikku, milles eralduvad kolm jämedat puutüve keskplaanil ja hõre põõsas paremal.
2043.de: A patch of green landscape painted with lush brushstrokes, in which three thick tree trunks stand out in the middle ground and a sparse bush on the right.

2045.d: Pildi keskel lookleva sillutamata tänava ääres vasakul hoogsate pintslilöökidega maalitud pruun ning selle kõrval valge akendeta maja. Pildi paremas servas valge maja ots, mille katust varjab pooleldi paremat ülanurka täitev roheline lehestik. All paremal laiade pintslilöökidega markeeritud kiviaed. Vasakul ülanurgas sinist, valkjashallide pilvedega taevast.
2045.de: In the centre of the picture, along a winding unpaved street, on the left a brown house painted with sweeping brushstrokes, and next to it a white house without windows. On the right edge of the picture, the end of a white house, whose roof is half-hidden by green foliage filling the upper right corner. Lower right, a stone wall marked with broad brushstrokes. In the upper left corner, a blue sky with whitish-grey clouds.

2047.d: Esiplaanil põllusiilul kummargil figuur, tema taga seisev mees ning sinises seelikus naine. Siin-seal maas rukkivihud. Taamal tuulik. Maalimislaad etüüdlik. Värvipilt - hele.
2047.de: In the foreground a figure bent over a stack of grain in the field, behind her a standing man and a woman in a blue skirt. Sheaves of rye lie here and there on the ground. A windmill in the distance. Sketch-like painting style. Bright colour scheme.

2048.d: Hallide, õlgadele langevate juuste ning habemega vanamehe peaetüüd, pöördega vasakule. Pea kummardatud ette, suu kergelt avatud.
2048.de: Head study of an old man with grey hair falling to the shoulders and a beard, turned to the left. Head bowed forward, mouth slightly open.

2050.d: Esiplaanil kiviaiaga ääristatud karjatee, sellel kaks lehma. Ees paremal, aia ääres seisev naine. Tagapool vasakul taluhooned, paremal mereäärne. Maal pruunikashallis koloriidis.
2050.de: In the foreground a cattle path bordered by a stone wall, with two cows on it. In front on the right, a woman standing by the wall. Beyond, on the left, farm buildings, on the right the seaside. The painting in a brownish-grey colour scheme.

2051.d: Hämaras ruumis toolil istuv mees profiilis vasakule. Mehel pikemad ülepea kammitud juuksed, põskhabe. Seljas tume kuub, põlvpüksid punaste tuttidega, pastlad jalas. Käed süles, paremaga hoiab kollakat karpi. Vasak jalg kõverdatult tooli jala juures. Tagapool paremal naise figuur. Maal tihketes hallides toonides.
2051.de: A man sitting on a chair in a dim room, in profile to the left. The man has longer hair combed back over his head, a beard on the cheeks. Wearing a dark coat, knee breeches with red tassels, sandals on his feet. Hands in his lap, holding a yellowish box with the right. Left leg bent by the leg of the chair. Behind, on the right, a woman's figure. The painting in dense grey tones.

2052.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 28.0 cm (km); lehe laius: 47.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 38.6 cm; kujutise laius: 34.0 cm (km)
2052.d: Pruunikashallil põllul paremal kolm mustendavat kartulivagu. Kaks naist äärmisel vasakpoolsel vaol, eespoolne kummargil, toetub parema käega korvile, selgvaates, tagumine otsevaates. Tagapool, paremal mees hobusega. Silmapiiril vasakul lage maastik, paremal puudegrupp ja talu. Maal hallikaspruunis, samblarohelises koloriidis.
2052.de: On a brownish-grey field, three blackening potato furrows on the right. Two women on the leftmost furrow, the one in front bent over, resting with her right hand on a basket, seen in profile, the one behind in a frontal view. Further back, on the right, a man with a horse. On the horizon, on the left an open landscape, on the right a group of trees and a farm. The painting is in a greyish-brown, moss-green colour scheme.

2054.d: Vanema mehe rinnaportree, profiilis. Tugev, veidi kongus nina, kitsad, kokkusurutud huuled, väikesed, sügaval asetsevad silmad. Suu ümbruses teravalt väljajoonistatud kortsud. Peas kaabu, seljas tume, pruunikas kuub. Värvigamma tume.
2054.de: Chest portrait of an older man, in profile. Strong, slightly hooked nose, narrow, pressed-together lips, small, deep-set eyes. Sharply defined wrinkles around the mouth. Wearing a hat on his head, a dark, brownish coat. Dark colour scheme.

2055.d: Heledapäise tütarlapse portree. Pea poolpöördes vasakule. Suurte, sügaval asetsevate, tumedate silmade pilk suunatud vaatajale. Lõua otsas lohk. Seljas lillakasroosa ja valge triibuline rõivastus.
2055.de: Portrait of a fair-haired girl. Head in a half-turn to the left. The gaze of large, deep-set, dark eyes directed at the viewer. A dimple at the tip of the chin. Wearing purplish-pink and white striped clothing.

2056.d: Vanema naise kolmveerandfiguur. Ülakeha veidi vasakule painutatud, pea kergelt ette kallutatud; käed rüpes. Seljas valged käised, mille kinniseks silmadega prees. Pead katab tumepruun rätt. Koloriit tume.
2056.de: Three-quarter figure of an older woman. Upper body bent slightly to the left, head tilted slightly forward; hands in her lap. Wearing white sleeves fastened with an eyelet brooch. Head covered with a dark brown kerchief. Dark colouring.

2057.d: Esiplaanil istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur, keha pöördes vasakule, vaade otse. Seljas punane, peente tumedate triipudega kampsun, peas karusnahkne müts. Taga vasakul seisab tumedas rõivastuses naine, pea poolpöördes paremale, käed kõverdatud vöökoha kõrgusele.
2057.de: In the foreground, three-quarter figure of a seated man, body turned to the left, gaze straight ahead. Wearing a red sweater with fine dark stripes, a fur cap on his head. Behind, on the left, stands a woman in dark clothing, head in a half-turn to the right, arms bent at waist height.

2058.d: Heledate vurrudega noore mehe rinnaportree. Vaade otse, keha kergelt vasakule pööratud. Seljas tume kuub ning hele särk, kaelas must kikilips. Peas, veidi üles koolutatud servadega kaabu. Maalimislaad etüüdlik.
2058.de: A bust portrait of a young man with light-colored moustache. Facing straight ahead, body turned slightly to the left. Wearing a dark coat and a light shirt, a black bow tie at the neck. On his head, a hat with slightly upturned brim. Sketch-like painting style.

2059.d: Vasakul, lahtiaetud kartulivagude vahel, viis naisefiguuri. Esiplaanil olev seisab, käed külgedel, keha kergelt pöördes paremale; seljas roosakas jakk. Taustaks kitsas meretriip ja pilvine taevas.
2059.de: On the left, between opened-up potato furrows, five female figures. The one in the foreground stands with her hands at her sides, body turned slightly to the right; wearing a pinkish jacket. Background a narrow strip of sea and a cloudy sky.

2060.d: Vanema mehe profiilportree. Suu kergelt avatud, pilk suunatud otse ette. Kaelas ookritoonis kaelarätt, seljas tume kuub. Foon hele, paremal tume.

2061.d: Paremal, pildi sügavusse looklev hall teelint. Vasakul, teeveerul valge hobune vankriga. Paremas servas paistab tükike kiviaeda ning maja otsasein. Taamal puud-põõsad, paar inimfiguuri, kooguga kaev.
2061.de: On the right, a grey road winding into the depth of the picture. On the left, at the roadside, a white horse with a cart. In the right margin a piece of stone wall and the gable end of a house are visible. In the distance trees and bushes, a couple of human figures, a well with a sweep.

2062.d: Kahvatusinise taeva taustal kerkib madala kellatorniga kirik. Kirikuesisel suuremate ja väiksemate gruppidena värvikates rahvariietes inimesed. Esiplaanil, all vasakus nurgas, valge hobune reega, selles istuva naise ning rakendi kõrval sammuva pruunis pikkkuues mehega. Koloriit hele. Maalitud etüüdlikult.
2062.de: Against a background of pale blue sky rises a church with a low bell tower. In front of the church, larger and smaller groups of people in colourful folk costumes. In the foreground, in the lower left corner, a white horse with a sledge, in which a woman sits, with a man in a brown long coat walking beside the harness. Light coloring. Painted in a study-like manner.

2081.de: Man's bust portrait, view to the right

2082.dm: lehe laius: 8.7 cm; lehe kõrgus: 12.0 cm
2082.de: Child's head in half-profile to the left

2083.d: Mehe rindportree poolprofiilis vasakule. Poolpikad lokkis juuksed, suus piip
2083.de: Chest portrait of a man in half-profile to the left. Half-long curly hair, a pipe in the mouth

2084.d: Vanema mehe pea poolprofiilis paremale, vaade suunatud üles
2084.de: Head of an elderly man in half-profile to the right, gaze directed upward

6078.d: Vaade Tallinnale Kadriorust. Mõlemas servas suured lehtpuud, keskel meres kivid, taustal Tallinna panoraam, mille kohal sinises taevas roosakad pilved.
6078.de: View of Tallinn from Kadriorg. On both edges large deciduous trees, in the centre rocks in the sea, in the background a panorama of Tallinn, above which in the blue sky pinkish clouds.

6501.dm: kõrgus: 29.5 cm (km); laius: 45.6 cm (pm); kõrgus: 32.0 cm (pm); laius: 44.7 cm (km)
6501.d: Esiplaanil lage maapind, tagapool lumelaike ja üksikud puutüved, ülaääres kitsas veeriba.
6501.de: In the foreground bare ground, behind it patches of snow and single tree trunks, at the upper edge a narrow strip of water.

6505.d: Madala hämara ruumi nurk. Vasakul seina ääres pikk pink istuva mehega. Paremal kirst. Vasakul ees näha osa aknapiidast.
6505.de: Corner of a low, dim room. On the left by the wall a long bench with a seated man. On the right a coffin. In the foreground on the left part of a window frame is visible.

6506.d: Ahju suu ees pingil tume nõu, selle kohal ripub triibuline rätik.
6506.de: In front of the furnace opening on a bench a dark vessel, above it hangs a striped towel.

6567.d: Pimedas talutoas, kuue väikese ruuduga akna all vasakul punase rätiga ketrav naine voki taga külgvaates. Paremal, akna all pingil istuv vana mees, pea maas, käed süles. Aknast tulev valgus loob põrandale helehalli laigu. Maal pruunis-hallis koloriidis.
6567.de: In a dark peasant room, under a six-paned window on the left, a woman with a red kerchief spinning at a spinning wheel in side view. On the right, an old man sitting on a bench under the window, head down, hands in his lap. Light coming from the window creates a light-grey patch on the floor. The painting is in a brown-grey colouring.

6568.d: Natuuritruu pruunikais-hallikais toonides heleda tausta ning tumeda alusega vaikelu. Pildi keskele on kolmnurkse kompositsiooniga asetatud nõud. Vasakul suurem pruun kauss, veidi tagapool tume anum, millele asetatud madalam kollakas-pruunikais toonides savist kauss puulusikaga. Paremale poole jääb väike plekk-kruus.
6568.de: A naturalistically true still life in brownish-grey tones with a light background and a dark base. Vessels are arranged in a triangular composition in the middle of the picture. On the left a larger brown bowl, slightly behind it a dark vessel on which a lower clay bowl in yellowish-brownish tones with a wooden spoon is placed. To the right there is a small tin cup.

6569.d: Ülaosas vasakul osa taluhoonest, avatud väravad. Tumedas ukseavas paistmas esemeid. Paremal ukse peal ripub vikat, vasakul ukse küljes riideesemeid. Ukse ees murul istub punases rätis laps. Seina ääres vasakul osa alumist maalipinda katmata. Hallikad, rohelised summutatud toonid.
6569.de: In the upper part on the left, part of a farm building, an open gate. Objects visible in the dark doorway. On the right a scythe hangs above the door, on the left items of clothing hang by the door. In front of the door a child in a red kerchief sits on the grass. Along the wall on the left part of the lower painting surface is left uncovered. Greyish, green muted tones.

6661.d: Vanema mehe rinnaportree, pea poolpöördes vasakule. Suu ümber sügavad kurrud, lõug veidi etteulatuv. Peas pruun, vasakule viltu vajutatud nokkmüts. Mütsi alt, külgedelt, paistavad heledad juuksekahlud. Seljas tumehall kuub ja pruunikas kaelarätt. Foon tume.
6661.de: Bust portrait of an older man, head in half-turn to the left. Deep creases around the mouth, chin slightly protruding. On his head a brown peaked cap tilted to the left. Light hair locks visible from under the cap at the sides. Wearing a dark grey coat and a brownish neckerchief. Background dark.

6664.d: Keskplaanis vasakul joogiküna samas seisva figuuriga. Viimasest vasakul lehm, teda kaelaümbert hoidva inimfiguuriga. Taamal talumajad. Koloriit hele, pruunikas-beežides toonides; käsitluslaad etüüdlik.
6664.de: In the middle ground on the left a drinking trough with a figure standing by it. To the left of the latter a cow, with a human figure holding it by the neck. Farmhouses in the distance. The colouring is light, in brownish-beige tones; the treatment is study-like.

6665.d: Paremal profiilis mehe rinnaportree. Peas laiaääreline kaabu. Tema kõrval otsevaates tüseda, vanema naise poolfiguur, käed puusas. Peas hele rätik. Taustaks maja otsasein ning kahvatusinine taevas. Allääres oleval pruunil pinnal paremal värvikihti kraabitud halvasti loetava käekirjaga justkui kellegi allkiri.
6665.de: On the right a bust portrait of a man in profile. On his head a wide-brimmed hat. Beside him a frontal half-figure of a stout, elderly woman, hands on hips. On her head a light-coloured headscarf. The background is the gable wall of a house and a pale blue sky. On the brown surface at the lower edge, on the right, a signature-like scraped paint layer in barely legible handwriting, as if someone's signature.

6666.d: Heledate vuntsidega noore mehe portree, profiilis. Pilk suunatud otse ette. Pruunid juuksed pehme lainena üle pea kammitud. Foon hall.
6666.de: Portrait of a young man with light moustache, in profile. Gaze directed straight ahead. Brown hair combed in a soft wave over the head. Background grey.

6667.d: Paremal kaks madalat, rookatustega taluhoonet. Majade juures suured heinakuhilad, samas askeldavad inimesed. Koloriit hele. Maalimislaad etüüdlik.
6667.de: On the right two low farm buildings with thatched roofs. Large haystacks by the houses, people busy about them. Colouring light. Painting manner sketch-like.

6668.d: Viljapõld rukkihakkidega. Vasakult lõikab põllusiilu kaheks kivine, rohetav riba. Taamal paremal paar viljakoristajat, vasakul puudesalu. Värvigamma hele, maalimislaad etüüdlik.
6668.de: Grain field with rye stooks. From the left, a stony, greenish strip cuts the field strip in two. In the distance on the right, a couple of harvesters, on the left a grove of trees. Colour palette light, sketch-like manner of painting.

6669.d: Heledates, säravates toonides maalitud mereäärne põllutükk viie naisefiguuriga, kes korvidega vagude vahel askeldavad. Maalimislaad etüüdlik.
6669.de: A seaside field painted in light, bright tones with five female figures busying themselves with baskets between the furrows. Study-like painting manner.

6670.d: Paremal pesuküna kohale kummardunud naine. Vasakul, alumises nurgas, lamav koer. Taustaks pruunides toonides maalitud kolm taluhoonet ja sinine taevalaik. Käsitluslaad etüüdlik.
6670.de: On the right, a woman bent over a washtub. On the left, in the lower corner, a lying dog. Background painted in brown tones with three farm buildings and a patch of blue sky. Sketch-like handling.

6671.d: Seljaga vaataja poole seisev, veidi ette kummardunud, pruunis vammuses, paljasjalgne naine. Peas hele tanu. Taustaks taluhoone.
6671.de: A barefoot woman standing with her back to the viewer, slightly bent forward, wearing a brown smock. A light cap on her head. A farmhouse in the background.

6673.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 33.5 cm (km); lehe laius: 56.0 cm (lm); lehe kõrgus: 37.2 cm (lm); kujutise laius: 52.7 cm (km)
6673.d: Esiplaanil kummuli paat, mida värvivad 4 meest. Samas seisab valges pearätis ja sinakas pluusis naine, käes mingi nõu. Paremas servas 2 figuuri. Taustaks taluhooned. Koloriit hele, osaliselt näha alusjoonis.
6673.de: In the foreground, an overturned boat being painted by 4 men. Also present, a woman in a white headscarf and bluish blouse, holding some kind of vessel. On the right edge, 2 figures. Farm buildings in the background. The colouring is light, the underdrawing is partially visible.

6677.d: Kollendaval viljapõllul valges särgis mehe täisfiguur; pea pöördes vasakule, peas nokkmüts. Paremas käes sirp, vasakus vili. Taamal, vasakus servas kaks viljahakki. Silmapiiril rohetav metsaviir. Koloriit hele.
6677.de: A full figure of a man in a white shirt in a yellowing grainfield; head turned to the left, wearing a peaked cap. In his right hand a sickle, in his left grain. Further back, on the left edge, two grain stacks. On the horizon a greenish strip of forest. Bright coloring.

6680.d: Poole pildipinnast võtab enda alla rohekas-beežides toonides maalitud maapind. Keskel, lattaia taga rookatusega taluhoone. Maja juures kaks suurt heinakuhja. Vasakus servas lehtpuu. Taevas sinine.
6680.de: Half of the picture surface is taken up by ground painted in greenish-beige tones. In the middle, behind a pole fence, a farm building with a thatched roof. Two large haystacks near the house. A deciduous tree at the left edge. Sky blue.

6681.d: Vasakult paremale läbib pilti diagonaaljoonena madal, osalt roigas-, osalt kiviaed. Silmapiiril, paremal grupp suuri lehtpuid ja nende vahelt paistvaid maju. Esiplaanil paremal kaks naisefiguuri. Koloriit hele.
6681.de: A low fence, partly made of poles, partly of stone, runs diagonally across the picture from left to right. On the horizon, on the right, a group of large deciduous trees with houses visible among them. In the foreground on the right, two female figures. Bright coloring.

6682.d: Lagedal põllul, pildi keskel hobune harkadra ning adrakurgi hoidva naisega. Silmapiiril, vasakul puude grupp ja madal, pikk taluhoone. Taevas pilves, horisondil selge. Koloriit hele, maalilaad etüüdlik.
6682.de: In an open field, in the middle of the picture a horse with a forked plough and a woman holding the plough handles. On the horizon, on the left, a group of trees and a low, long farm building. The sky cloudy, clear at the horizon. The colouring bright, the painting style sketch-like.

6683.d: Paremal, keskplaani jäävate talumajade taustal kaks naisefiguuri. Ühel käes korv kartulitega, teine kummardumas vao kohale. Silmapiiril vasakul metsaviirg, paremal merelaht. Poole pildi pinnast võtab enda alla üksikute valkjate pilveräpsudega taevas.
6683.de: On the right, against the background of farmhouses receding into the middle ground, two female figures. One holds a basket of potatoes, the other bending over a furrow. On the horizon at the left a strip of forest, at the right a sea bay. Half of the picture surface is taken up by a sky with scattered whitish wisps of cloud.

6684.d: Kangaspuude taga istub küljega vaataja poole heledas pluusis ning rätis keskealine naine. Temast vasakul istuv mehefiguur. Koloriit hele.
6684.de: Behind the loom sits, in profile toward the viewer, a middle-aged woman in a light blouse and headscarf. To her left sits a male figure. Light colouring.

6687.d: Kollakal viljapõllu siilul neli inimfiguuri. Silmapiiril puudegrupid. Taevas tume, pilves.
6687.de: On a yellowish grain field ridge four human figures. Groups of trees on the horizon. The sky is dark, cloudy.

6690.d: Lillakaspunaste võrade ja heledate tüvedega kaskede all kalmistu. Muruplatsidel üksikud ristid, platside vahelt kulgevad jalgrajad. Taamal vasakul valgete seinte ja halli suletud uksega kabel. Esiplaanil, vertikaalsest keskjoonest pisut paremal, tumedas seelikus ja punakas mütsis üksik naisefiguur. Ülal paremal tuhmsinine taevas.
6690.de: A cemetery beneath purplish-red crowns and pale trunks of birches. Individual crosses on the grass plots, footpaths running between the plots. In the background on the left, a chapel with white walls and a closed grey door. In the foreground, slightly right of the vertical centre line, a single female figure in a dark skirt and reddish cap. Above on the right, a dull blue sky.

6745.d: Kivisel rannikul paremal väike kõrgendik, millel linnuse varemed. Linnuse taga paistab kaugemal oleva maja katus. Ees paremal kuivama riputatud kalavõrgud. Linnuse ümber karjatara. Vasakul madal lahesopp, milles varemete peegeldus. Eespool paar suuremat kivi, taga kaugemal üksik purjekas. Taevas maastiku kohal ühtlaselt helesinine, kahvatukollane päike loojumas.
6745.de: On a rocky coast, on the right, a small elevation with the ruins of a castle. Behind the castle, the roof of a more distant house is visible. In front, on the right, fishing nets hung out to dry. Around the castle, a pasture fence. On the left, a shallow bay inlet, in which the ruins are reflected. In front, a couple of larger stones, further back a solitary sailboat. Above the landscape, the sky is evenly light blue, with a pale yellow sun setting.

6791.d: Pisike naine keskelt vöötatud pikas hallis kleidis, kaelusega veinpunane rätik. Pea pööratud pisut paremale, tumedad juuksed kuklasse kinnitatud, pisike otsmik krimpsus. Käed kokkupandult süles tumehallil põllel. Foon vasakult hall, paremalt pruunides toonides.
6791.de: A small woman in a long grey dress belted at the waist, with a wine-red scarf at the collar. Her head is turned slightly to the right, dark hair fastened at the back of her head, a small wrinkled forehead. Her hands are folded in her lap on a dark grey apron. The background is grey on the left, in brown tones on the right.

6792.d: Hallipäise, vuntside ja väikese lõuahabemega mehe rinnaportree. Mehe pea pööratud pisut vasakule, seljas tume kuub, valge särk ja kaelaside. Foon hall.
6792.de: Bust portrait of a grey-haired man with a moustache and a small chin beard. The man's head turned slightly to the left, wearing a dark coat, white shirt and necktie. Background grey.

6796.d: Keskel suure, terava viiluga katusega hall palkmaja, mille otsas küljel kaks heledaks värvitud rõdu. Maja ees rohelisel murul on markeeritud kolm inimfiguuri, maja taga puud. Ülal hall pilvine taevas.
6796.de: In the middle a grey log house with a large, sharp gable roof, at the end of which, on the side, two light-coloured painted balconies. In front of the house on the green grass three human figures are indicated, behind the house trees. Above, a grey cloudy sky.

6798.d: Esiplaanil vasakul tumepruun paat, millele toetub võrku parandav mees. Mehel seljas valge särk ja pruun vest, pruunide pükste vasak säär põlveni üles keeratud. Peas pooleldi nägu varjav pruun kaabu. Foonil üksiku väikese laevaga meri, silmapiiril metsaga kaetud maariba. Ülal hallikassinine taevas.
6798.de: In the foreground on the left, a dark brown boat, against which a man repairing a net is leaning. The man wears a white shirt and a brown waistcoat, the left leg of his brown trousers is rolled up to the knee. On his head a brown hat, half-covering his face. In the background, the sea with a single small ship, a strip of forested land on the horizon. Above, a greyish-blue sky.

7909.d: Esiplaanil vasakul suurem veekogu. Paremal nurgas näha väikene nurk kivist kallast. Taamal vastaskaldail, järskude mägede jalameil hooneteread.

7918.d: Esiplaanil hoov - paremal majadegrupp, vasakul tara ja puu. Taga kaks vana linnamüüri kindlustorni, majade katused ja Oleviste kiiver.
7918.de: In the foreground a yard - on the right a group of houses, on the left a fence and a tree. Behind, two old town wall fortification towers, the roofs of houses and the spire of Oleviste.

7925.d: Paremal järv kivise kaldaga, vasakul, kaldal mägionnid, taga kõrgemad roosalt helkivate latvadega. Põhitoonid: lillakas sinine, sinine, pruun.
7925.de: On the right a lake with a stony shore, on the left, on the shore, mountain huts, behind them higher ones with pinkish glowing tops. Main tones: purplish blue, blue, brown.

7956.d: Plikakese rinnapilt kerge peapöördega paremale, rinnal juuksepalmik roosa lindiga, vaöges kleidis. Pasparteeritud, nurgeti nelikurnsel alusraamil.
7956.de: Chest-length picture of a little girl with a slight turn of the head to the right, on her chest a hair braid with a pink ribbon, in a striped dress. Mounted, in a rectangular frame set at an angle.

7993.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, mille vasak nurk rohtu kasvanud. Vasakul üksik jändrik kask. Taga teisel kaldal kauged puude ja põõsaste grupid. Horisont pildi keskel.
7993.de: In the foreground a body of water, its left corner overgrown with grass. On the left a solitary stunted birch. Behind, on the other shore, distant groups of trees and bushes. Horizon in the middle of the picture.

7996.d: Esiplaanil rohkete veetaimedega veekogu sinna peegelduva kaldarohelusega. Üle vee madal kallas mitut liiki kõrgete puudega. Helehallis taevas valged pilved. Maalitud kroomrohelistes toonides detailitäpselt.
7996.de: In the foreground a body of water with abundant water plants, with the greenery of the bank reflected in it. Beyond the water, a low shore with several kinds of tall trees. In a light grey sky, white clouds. Painted in chrome-green tones with detailed precision.

8174.d: Keskplaanil kolm puud, nendest keskmine ja parempoolne raagus. Vasakpoolne lehtes. Keskmise puu taga suitseva korstnaga hoone, parempoolse puu taga viilkatusega hoone. Puudest vasakul jõgi. Jõel üksik lootsik. Jõe vasakpoolsel kaldal üksik lehispuu. Taevas loojuva päikese kumaga.
8174.de: In the middle plane three trees, of which the middle and right ones are bare. The left one is leafy. On the left bank of the river a single larch tree. The sky glows with the setting sun.

8252.d: Esiplaanil lumine raagus puu ja paat; vasemal jäätunud jõgi; paremal lummeuppunud majakesed ja kasesalu. Taamalt jõe kohalt langeb maastikule loojuva päikese  punakas helk.
8252.de: In the foreground a snowy leafless tree and a boat; on the left a frozen river; on the right small houses sunk in snowdrifts and a birch grove. From above the river a reddish glow of the setting sun falls on the landscape.

8256.d: Esiplaanil osa laeva laest, üksiku, kuust valgustatud merd vaatava naise figuuriga reelingu ääres.
8256.de: In the foreground part of a ship's ceiling, with the figure of a lonely woman lit by the moon, looking at the sea by the railing.

8270.de: On the foreground, on the bank of a stream curving gently to the left toward the middle, among trees, a farmhouse with a snow-covered roof and a smoking chimney. Near the building a boat frozen into the ice. On the other bank of the stream in the foreground, gnarled bare birches, further back mixed forest. The whole area is enlivened by a sky reddened by the setting sun, and its reflections on the icy surface of the stream.

In the man's strong hands, a small round tobacco box.

10043.de: Half-figure of a young woman in frontal view, head turned to the left, in a brown pelisse with a lace ruche around the neckline. A medallion on a fine chain around the neck. An earring in the ear.
